ROW.COLUMN: (ML/AC) High Risk Transactions: High Risk Geography

Financial institutions are expected to apply enhanced scrutiny to transactions both to and from areas considered high risk. Because of the large volume and speed of transactions, electronic funds transactions are considered particularly vulnerable to money laundering. This scenario identifies accounts or entities that may be at risk based on the the incidence of electronic funds transfers, checks, or monetary instrument transactions involving specified high-risk geographic areas.
